definitions.explanation: A wheeled platform used to transport heavy or bulky items. Common in warehouses, factories, moving operations, and retail stores.

examples.japanese: {台車|だいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: To transport luggage on a hand cart.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{台車|だいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a dolly when I moved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{台車|だいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せて→載せる：28290_noseru⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: I loaded cardboard boxes onto a dolly and transported them from the warehouse.

notes:
{台車|だいしゃ} is a wheeled platform used to move heavy or bulky items. Commonly seen in warehouses, factories, moving operations, and retail stores.

ETYMOLOGY:
{台|だい} (stand, platform) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (wheel, vehicle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台車|だいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to transport by hand cart
- {台車|だいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: to load onto a cart
- {台車|だいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to push a cart
- {台車|だいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to borrow a cart

USAGE:
A practical everyday word. You may see signs saying {台車|だいしゃ}{貸|か}し{出|だ}し (cart rental/lending) at home improvement stores and moving companies. Some supermarkets and airports also provide {台車|だいしゃ} for customer use.
